title.narrative: Addressing Food Security Crisis in Borno through a targeted WASH response

description.narrative:
ltpgtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtAs of mid-2023, North-East Nigeria is approaching two severe crisis on top of the protracted displacement crisis in the area:ltbrgtlt/spangt-An important food security crisis is looming expecting unprecedented numbersltbrgt-The recurring cholera outbreak that occurs almost every rainy season in this part of Nigeria.lt/pgt
ltpgtltspangtTo respond to these, SI, together with their local partner Salient Humanitarian Organization (SHO) is proposing a 2-pronged approach:ltbrgtlt/spangt-Providing static locations with a Wash response aiming at preventing cholera outbreaks and contributing to the reduction of malnutrition by ensuring access to safe water and reducing risk of transmission of vectors. This shall be implemented in the LGAs of Monguno, Dikwa and Gwoza. This shall be done under the first Output of this project and should target approximately 12,500 individuals.ltbrgt-Maintaining a flexible capacity to respond where higher needs arise in the following LGAs: Bama, Gwoza, Damboa, Dikwa, Monguno, Ngala, and Magumeri. This shall be done under the second Output and target 5,000 individuals.ltbrgtltspangtltbgtltbrgtSHO has previously worked with NHF in Nigeria and was assessed as having a Medium Risk rating according to recent NHF evaluation.ltbrgtlt/bgtlt/spangtltbrgtBoth responses would include similar activities, but for which the trigger or the modality may differ from one output to the other.lt/pgt
ltpgtltbrgtThese include:ltbrgt-Provision of safe water: be it through durable methods (rehabilitation of 4 production boreholes, coupled with reform of WASH management committees) or rather responding to emergency alert measures (repairs to at least 1 production borehole,, repairs to 2 manual hand pumps, chlorination of 20 water points, water trucking – capacity for 3,000m3).ltbrgt-Provision of safe sanitation: through rehabilitation of communal sanitation block latriness in camps or different public facilities (20 blocks under output 1, 16 under ouput 2) and desludging of 2670 latrine cubicles under output 2.ltbrgt-Provision of hygiene promotion – accompanied with hand washing with soap demonstrations .ltbrgt-Supply of NFI kit: either hygiene kits (1,300), SAM/cholera kits (1,056) or CATI kits (700) to support most vulnerable families impacted by malnutrition and/or cholera.ltbrgt-Potential support to one Cholera Treatment Centre as required.ltbrgtIn terms of area of coverage, SI is already present since 2016 in Monguno and Dikwa. Si shall implement jointly with SHO w in Dikwa and Gwoza for the first output. For the second output, the aim is to be as inclusive as possible in the geographical capacity to respond, SI and SHO will ensure that security assessments are performed before any deployment of the RRM team in new locations. This security assessment shall condition the partner's capacity to respond.ltbrgt ltbrgtOverall, the project should cover the needs of 17,500 beneficiaries (3,589 men, 4,039 women, 4527 boys, 5,325 girls)ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
